findings.evidence: Basic.lean:19 says the definitions follow Burde–Zieschang 1.1, but roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/GeometricTopology/references/bz-knot-foundations.md:31-34 states that the level-preserving map `F : X × I → Y × I` is an embedding; Basic.lean:80-81 encodes only `∀ t, IsEmbedding (F t)`.
findings.fix: Restore the total-map embedding field, or change the mathematical specification and sourcing throughout so the weaker slice-wise notion is explicitly distinguished from Burde–Zieschang isotopy.
findings.issue: `Isotopy` requires only each slice to be an embedding, while the module claims to follow Burde–Zieschang Definition 1.1, which requires the level-preserving total map `X × I → Y × I` itself to be an embedding; these conditions are not equivalent for arbitrary topological spaces.

summary: The new slice-wise predicate is strictly weaker than the cited isotopy definition, so the implementation is not faithful to its stated mathematical source.
